errorCodes.about: A field is missing or has the wrong type or value; field and reason say which and why.
No such bloom, sprig, item, sound, source, filter or place; what and name say what was asked for.
It can't be done here, e.g. putting a sprig on air.
Already doing it (already live), or the name is taken (reason already_exists).
Going live or recording would have asked first: nothing started; warnings lists why, force: true goes ahead.
stream.start was given places and the places switched on aren't exactly those: nothing started; places lists the ones switched on.
The action comes with a store plugin that isn't added; the message names it.

errorReasons.about: A field that's needed wasn't sent.
A field has the wrong type (text where a number goes...).
A number is outside what the field takes.
A word the field doesn't take.

closeCodes.about: SprigCast closed, or its API was turned off (app.closing came first).
A message wasn't a JSON object.
Wrong or expired pairing code, or too many wrong codes (pairing locks for a minute).

actions.name: app.actions
actions.about: Every action with what it does and its fields (fields starting with ? are optional).

actions.name: app.broadcast
actions.about: Send your own event to every connected app.

actions.name: app.info
actions.about: Version, API version, the shapes that are on, each canvas's size, event groups and features.

actions.name: app.protocol
actions.about: The whole API described for programs: every action with typed fields (type, needed, default, range, words it takes), every event, error code, error reason and close code.

actions.name: app.stats
actions.about: Frames per second, render time and memory.

actions.name: bloom.current
actions.about: The bloom on air in each shape.

actions.name: bloom.new
actions.about: Make an empty bloom (with its own sprig, where what you add goes).

fields.name: shape
fields.about: both (default: every canvas), horizontal or vertical

actions.name: bloom.remove
actions.about: Remove a bloom (in every shape). Its sources stay while other blooms use them.

actions.name: bloom.show
actions.about: Put a bloom on air.

actions.name: blooms.list
actions.about: Every bloom, its shapes and which shapes it's on air in.

actions.name: camera.set
actions.about: Turn SprigCast Camera on or off (no on: toggle).

actions.name: camera.status
actions.about: Whether SprigCast Camera (the virtual camera) is on.

actions.name: clip.save
actions.about: Save the last seconds as a clip (gets clips ready first if they're off). Answers with the file names at once; the clip.saved event says when they are written. clip is true when a clip is being saved; when it is false, note says why and when one can be.

actions.name: clips.set
actions.about: Keep clips ready (on) or stop (off).

actions.name: clips.status
actions.about: Whether clips are ready and how long a clip is.

actions.name: edit.redo
actions.about: Put back the change that was just undone (as Ctrl+Y in SprigCast).

actions.name: edit.undo
actions.about: Undo the last change to the garden (as Ctrl+Z in SprigCast).

actions.name: filter.add
actions.about: Add a filter to a source or a placed sprig.

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: filter.move
actions.about: Move a filter to a new place in the list (0 = top).

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: filter.remove
actions.about: Remove a filter from a source or a placed sprig.

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: filter.set
actions.about: Turn a filter on or off and/or change some of its settings (others stay).

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: filter.toggle
actions.about: Turn a filter on if off, off if on.

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: filters.kinds
actions.about: Filter kinds you can add, with their settings and limits.

actions.name: filters.list
actions.about: A source's or a placed sprig's filters, top to bottom.

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: filters.share
actions.about: A placed sprig: the same filters on both canvases (the usual), or its own on each.

fields.name: sprig
fields.about: a sprig instead: its filters where it's placed

fields.name: in
fields.about: with sprig: only where it's placed in this bloom or sprig (both canvases)

actions.name: garden.new
actions.about: Make a garden and switch to it: empty, or a copy of one.

actions.name: garden.switch
actions.about: Switch to another garden.

actions.name: gardens.list
actions.about: Every garden (a whole set of blooms) A-Z, and the one in use.

actions.name: hotkey.list
actions.about: Hotkey actions and what they do.

actions.name: hotkey.run
actions.about: Do what a hotkey does (hotkey.list shows them). note says why when it couldn't.

actions.name: item.add
actions.about: Put a source in a bloom (in its sprig) or a sprig, on top (a plugin starts readable, in a free corner). Answers the item's id.

actions.name: item.duplicate
actions.about: Copy something in a bloom or sprig: a new source with the same settings and filters, placed the same way, on top. Sprigs can't be copied this way.

fields.name: name
fields.about: the copy's name (default: its name and a number)

actions.name: item.hide
actions.about: Hide something inside a bloom or sprig.

actions.name: item.lock
actions.about: Lock something in place in Build, or unlock it (no locked: toggle).

actions.name: item.order
actions.about: Bring something forward or send it back.

fields.name: to
fields.about: top, bottom, up (one step) or down (one step)

actions.name: item.place
actions.about: Move, size or turn something inside a bloom or sprig (only the fields you give change).

fields.name: scale
fields.about: size, 1 = as big as the source

fields.name: scale_x
fields.about: width only, 1 = as wide as the source

fields.name: scale_y
fields.about: height only, 1 = as tall as the source

fields.name: crop
fields.about: {left, top, right, bottom} in source pixels (the sides you give change)

fields.name: bounds
fields.about: off, fit, fill or stretch: squeeze it into a box

fields.name: bounds_align
fields.about: where the picture sits in its box (top_left ... center ... bottom_right)

fields.name: align
fields.about: the point it turns around (top_left ... center ... bottom_right); the picture stays where it is

actions.name: item.remove
actions.about: Take something out of a bloom or sprig. Its source stays (source.remove removes that).

actions.name: item.show
actions.about: Show something inside a bloom or sprig.

actions.name: item.status
actions.about: Whether something inside a bloom or sprig is shown.

actions.name: item.toggle
actions.about: Show it if hidden, hide it if shown.

actions.name: items.list
actions.about: What's inside a bloom or sprig, per shape.

actions.name: layout.get
actions.about: Where everything in a bloom or sprig sits, per shape, top of the stack first: each item's place, crop, bounds, its source's own size and its box on the canvas. Sprigs carry what's inside them.

fields.name: flat
fields.about: true: only the things themselves (no sprigs), as they end up on the canvas

fields.name: overlaps
fields.about: true: also the pairs of shown things whose boxes overlap

actions.name: media.list
actions.about: Every video and sound file, with what it's doing (playing, paused, stopped, ended).

actions.name: media.loop
actions.about: Loop it or not (no on: toggle).

actions.name: media.pause
actions.about: Pause where it is.

actions.name: media.play
actions.about: Play (from the start if it ended or was stopped).

actions.name: media.restart
actions.about: Play from the start.

actions.name: media.seek
actions.about: Jump to a time.

actions.name: media.status
actions.about: What a video or sound file is doing, where it is and how long it is.

actions.name: media.stop
actions.about: Stop and show nothing (play starts from the beginning).

actions.name: media.toggle
actions.about: Pause if playing, else play.

actions.name: path.new
actions.about: Make a path and switch to it: empty, or a copy of one.

actions.name: path.switch
actions.about: Switch to another path (not while live or recording).

actions.name: paths.list
actions.about: Every path (where and how you go out: places, encoder, recording) A-Z, and the one in use.

actions.name: place.set
actions.about: Switch a place on or off for the next Go live, and/or its test mode (Twitch: the stream reaches Twitch but viewers never see it).

fields.name: bandwidth_test
fields.about: true or false (only places whose service has a test mode)

fields.name: bitrateKbps
fields.about: 500 to 50000: its bitrate for the next Go live

actions.name: place.start
actions.about: While live: start sending to one more place (switched on for next time too).

actions.name: place.stop
actions.about: While live: stop sending to one place (the others keep going; the last one ends the stream).

actions.name: places.list
actions.about: Where the stream goes (Twitch, YouTube...), each one's shape and if it's on.

actions.name: plugins.list
actions.about: The plugins that are added (enabled) and the store's others (not enabled), each with the actions it brings.

actions.name: record.chapter
actions.about: Add a chapter mark to the recording at this moment (editors and players list them).

actions.name: record.pause
actions.about: Pause the recording. The file stays open; record.resume carries on in it.

actions.name: record.resume
actions.about: Carry on recording in the same file after record.pause.

actions.name: record.start
actions.about: Start recording. If the drive is nearly full, nothing starts: doctor_warnings says so.

actions.name: record.status
actions.about: Recording or not, for how long, the file, and whether it's paused.

actions.name: record.stop
actions.about: Stop recording.

actions.name: record.toggle
actions.about: Start or stop recording (starting answers like record.start).

actions.name: record.toggle_pause
actions.about: Pause, or carry on after a pause.

actions.name: screenshot.take
actions.about: A picture of what's on air in each shape, or of one source or bloom.

fields.name: source
fields.about: just this source (a camera...), name or id

fields.name: bloom
fields.about: just this bloom, name or id

fields.name: width
fields.about: shrink to this width in pixels (keeps the shape)

fields.name: save
fields.about: true (default): save PNGs in the recordings folder, under Screenshots

fields.name: data
fields.about: true: send the picture back as base64 PNG (for bots and pages; large)

actions.name: sound.balance
actions.about: Left/right: -1 left, 0 middle, 1 right.

actions.name: sound.micFirst
actions.about: Lower everything else while your mic talks (ducking).

actions.name: sound.mute
actions.about: Mute or unmute a sound (no muted: toggle).

actions.name: sound.volume
actions.about: Set a sound's volume in dB, or change it by some dB.

actions.name: sounds.list
actions.about: Every sound in the mixer with its volume and mute.

actions.name: source.get
actions.about: A source's settings.

actions.name: source.new
actions.about: Make a source (a browser page, text, image...). Put it in a bloom with item.add.

actions.name: source.refresh
actions.about: Load a web page source again, now.

actions.name: source.remove
actions.about: Remove a source, taking it out of every bloom and sprig it's in.

actions.name: source.rename
actions.about: Give a source a new name.

actions.name: source.rotate
actions.about: Turn a source to an angle wherever it's shown (0: upright again).

actions.name: source.set
actions.about: Change some of a source's settings: text, a browser page's url, an image file, a color...

actions.name: sources.list
actions.about: Every source (cameras, text, browser pages, images, sounds...).

actions.name: sprig.remove
actions.about: Remove a sprig in every shape, and take it out of every bloom. Sources only it used go too, except sounds (mics, desktop and app sounds), which always stay.

actions.name: sprig.state
actions.about: Switch a sprig to one of its Live states (null: as built).

actions.name: sprigs.list
actions.about: Every sprig, its Live states and the state showing.

actions.name: stream.start
actions.about: Go live to every place that's switched on; the answer lists them (places). If the Stream doctor would warn first, nothing starts: doctor_warnings lists them. places: the ids you expect to go live; if the places switched on differ, nothing starts (places_differ lists them).

fields.name: force
fields.about: true: go live past the doctor's warnings

fields.name: places
fields.about: list of place ids from places.list: go live only if exactly these are switched on

actions.name: stream.status
actions.about: Live or not, for how long, dropped frames, and each place on its own.

actions.name: stream.stop
actions.about: End the stream.

actions.name: stream.toggle
actions.about: Go live, or end the stream (going live answers like stream.start).

fields.name: force
fields.about: true: go live past the doctor's warnings

actions.name: transition.get
actions.about: The usual transition, its length and (Move) how it moves.

actions.name: transition.set
actions.about: Change the usual transition, its length and (Move) how it moves.

fields.name: kind
fields.about: cut, fade, move, slide, swipe, wipe, leaf, bloom, stinger

fields.name: easing
fields.about: Move only: smooth, ease_out, ease_in, linear, spring

fields.name: unmatched
fields.about: Move only, what only one bloom shows: fade, scale, slide

actions.name: viewers.counts
actions.about: While live: how many watch on each platform (YouTube, Twitch, Kick), read at most once a minute; never waits. A platform not live: live false; viewers null: no number yet.

actions.name: youtube.viewers
actions.about: While live on YouTube: how many watch, in all and on each YouTube stream (read from YouTube at most once a minute; never waits). Not live there or not signed in: live false.
